qualification.education_qualification: Graduate (Arts/Science/Commerce) from a recognized University with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade, and a Computer Certificate/Diploma of minimum 6 months duration with good knowledge of English DTP.
qualification.details: Qualification: Graduate (Arts/Science/Commerce) from a recognized University with minimum of 55% of marks or equivalent grade; Computer Certificate/ Diploma of minimum 6 (Six) months duration with good knowledge of English DTP Experience: Desirable: minimum 1 year of relevant post qualification experience in office management, proper drafting, file management etc. in Government or any reputed organization Age limit: 26 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) | Other conditions: | Good knowledge of English DTP required | Desirable: | Minimum 1 year of relevant post qualification experience in office management, proper drafting, file management etc. in Government or any reputed organization Preference: working in similar capacity in Government projects/PSU/Externally aided projects Preference: knowledge of Government accounting, taxations, etc.

salary_details.pay_scale: Fixed Rs.20,000 per month with 3% annual increment in case of continuance

how_to_apply: Fill up the prescribed Application Format (Candidate Information Form) attached with the advertisement.
Mail only the duly filled-up Application Format to [email protected].
Last date of submission through email is 06/12/2026; no application entertained after 06/12/2026, 11.59 PM.
In-service applicants must apply through proper channel.
Submit one set of self-attested documents with the Application Format before attending the Interview.
important_instructions: Incomplete and improper applications shall summarily be rejected No TA/DA for appearing in Document Verification, Writing Skill & Computer Literacy Test and Interview Candidature may be cancelled whenever any ineligibility is detected False information will be penalized as per prevailing laws/rules Decision of the authority regarding eligibility shall be final

rows.adarsha_vidyalaya_sangathan_assam_avs_gu: Fixed Rs.20,000 per month with 3% annual increment in case of continuance
State Office, Adarsha Vidyalaya Sangathan, Assam, Kahilipara, Guwahati

Graduate (Arts/Science/Commerce) from a recognized University with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade, and a Computer Certificate/Diploma of minimum 6 months duration with good knowledge of English DTP.

content_sections.heading: AVS Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. AVS/RSO/2022/01/208 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download AVS notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduate (Arts/Science/Commerce) from a recognized University with minimum of 55% of marks or equivalent grade; Computer Certificate/ Diploma of minimum 6 (Six) months duration with good knowledge of English DTP Experience: Desirable: minimum 1 year of relevant post qualification experience in office management, proper drafting, file management etc. in Government or any reputed organization Age limit: 26 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Good knowledge of English DTP required Desirable: Minimum 1 year of relevant post qualification experience in office management, proper drafting, file management etc. in Government or any reputed organization Preference: working in similar capacity in Government projects/PSU/Externally aided projects Preference: knowledge of Government accounting, taxations, etc.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AVS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who are not permanent residents of Assam

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engagement purely on contractual basis for 11 (Eleven) months Extension of service based on satisfactory annual performance 3% annual increment in case of continuance

rows.event: Last Date of Submission of Application Form through Email (till 11.59 PM)
Publication of Merit List of Eligible Candidates (5.00 PM)
Document Verification, Writing Skill, Computer Literacy Test and Interview (10.30 AM onwards)

content_sections.heading: How Will AVS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document Verification Merit List of eligible candidates Writing Skill Test Computer Literacy Test Interview Document Verification after receipt of applications by email Merit List of eligible candidates published on the official website on 07/12/2026 at 5.00 PM Writing Skill, Computer Literacy Test and Interview on 11/12/2026 for eligible candidates If applicants are many, 1:10 applicants called for Document Verification & Interview purely based on merit Interview by a duly formed Selection Committee comprising subject experts

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of all academic marks-sheets and pass certificates Self-attested age proof Originals of all the above to be brought for the Interview

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete and improper applications shall summarily be rejected No TA/DA for appearing in Document Verification, Writing Skill & Computer Literacy Test and Interview Candidature may be cancelled whenever any ineligibility is detected False information will be penalized as per prevailing laws/rules Decision of the authority regarding eligibility shall be final
